About the Firm

Your matter is consequential. We treat it that way.

Most attorneys handle your matter. Few understand the full weight of what's at stake — the reputation behind the contract, the family behind the visa, the business behind the compliance exposure.

UOA Legal was built on a different premise: that the highest-stakes legal matters demand counsel who can see across disciplines, anticipate second-order effects, and execute without hesitation.

We do not practice law transactionally. We practice it strategically.

Principal Attorney

Udoka Obie Amah, Esq.

Founder & Principal

Dual-qualified in New York and Texas, with 18+ years of experience across federal litigation, corporate compliance, cross-border advisory, and complex legal structuring.

Before founding UOA Legal, he served as Anti-Bribery & Corruption Lead at Shell SPDC — operating under a U.S. Department of Justice Deferred Prosecution Agreement, one of the most demanding regulatory environments in global energy. That experience produced something most attorneys don't have: a litigation-informed, risk-calibrated instinct that surfaces problems before they become crises.

He has appeared before federal courts including the U.S. Court of International Trade, prosecuted Article 78 proceedings against New York State agencies, and built elite legal strategies for global founders, executives, and investors.

How We Work

Four principles. Non-negotiable.

01

We take a limited number of matters. You get the full attention of Attorney Amah — not a junior associate.

02

We think in systems. Every matter has upstream causes and downstream consequences. We map the full risk landscape before we move.

03

We operate discreetly. Our clients expect confidentiality as a default — not an afterthought.

04

We deliver outcomes. Not just legal opinions. Strategies that hold under scrutiny and protect what you've built.
